name: ai-knowhow
description: Know how it was built. Know what to build it with. Two open-source agent skills: modelwise (right model, effort and prompt for any task) and retrace (turn finished AI work into lessons that teach people).

plugins.name: modelwise
plugins.description: Turn a basic prompt into the right Anthropic/OpenAI model, effort level and a structured, model-specific prompt, with cost estimates and token-saving tips.

plugins.name: retrace
plugins.description: Capture how an AI-assisted task was done (decisions, prompts, mistakes, cheaper path) as a lesson skill, and teach it to people.
